description: This file defines the CreateContentTask class, a workflow activity for creating content items within OrchardCore CMS. It manages content creation, validation, publishing, and handles inline event scenarios to prevent infinite loops.

classes.name: CreateContentTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for creating content items, supporting content type specification, publishing options, and inline event handling to prevent infinite loops.

methods.name: CreateContentTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for content management, expression evaluation, localization, and JavaScript encoding.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity, 'CreateContentTask'.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category 'Content' for this activity.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the display text 'Create Content Task' for UI purposes.

methods.name: ContentType
methods.description: Property to get or set the type of content to create.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Property to determine if the created content should be published.

methods.name: ContentProperties
methods.description: Workflow expression for additional content properties, with default serialization of a display text prompt.

methods.name: CanExecute
methods.description: Checks if the activity can execute based on whether ContentType is specified.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Performs the content creation process, including inline event checks, content initialization, validation, creation, publishing, and updating workflow context.
